title: Null control: Tokyo temp anomaly vs TTF returns
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] NULL CONTROL: Tokyo temperature anomaly 20d z-score > 1 should show no lead on TTF log returns at lags 0-10 days (expected zero); trade none [weather.tokyo.temp_anomaly -> finance.TTF=F.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.tokyo.temp_anomaly rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 10 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Tokyo temperature anomaly 20d z-score > 1 (cold/heat demand shock proxy) leads the TTF/Henry Hub ratio (+) at 1-5 days more than raw TTF returns [weather.tokyo.temp_anomaly -> finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub] (parent: R2-0038)
